saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Αφροδίσιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and it is the only Aphrodisius in the corpus. The details match the folder's life: Cilicia, the ruler Dionysius, the burning with heated iron, and death crushed between two great stones. The page puts his martyrdom in a year the folder does not carry — its heading reads «(; - 65)» and its narrative «Το 65 μ.Χ., ο άρχοντας Διονύσιος … τον καταδίκασε σε θάνατο» — and it adds a wonder the folder's life does not have, that he was first thrown to a lioness in the amphitheatre and that the hungry beast stopped a few paces short of him and passed him by. No `dates` object is proposed here, because a year the second source alone gives is a reading for the report and not a correction of the first. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn under his line.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
